budget.metric: relative error of the simulated stability limit (limiting axial depth) at the spindle speed of the reference: benchmark curves point by point; a stable test bounds the limit from below and a chatter test from above (only the error on the wrong side counts); border tests and chatter frequencies two-sided
budget.note: The limit at a lobe minimum is a_lim = 1 / (2 Kt mu |Re G|min) with |Re G|min about 1 / (2 zeta k) for one dominant mode (Tlusty, Altintas & Budak 1995), so its relative error is the root sum of the errors of the cutting coefficient (cutting_force budget 15 %), the modal stiffness (tool-point compliance uncertain by about 15 %, docs/models/structure.md) and the damping ratio (impact-test damping uncertain by tens of per cent): about 25 %. The experiments resolve the border only to their depth step: 0.5 mm steps at 1-6.5 mm (Weck 1993: 8-50 %), 0.2 mm steps at 0.2-1 mm (Insperger 2006). On lobe flanks a 1 % shift in speed changes the limit by tens of per cent, which this budget covers only near the minima; the benchmark charts carry 0.05 mm (2 % of their depth scale) and the 50 rpm grid blunting of the source.
